title: Can AI Guide Testing Without Generating Tests? A Comparative Study of AI-Assisted Unit Testing
abstract: arXiv:2610.36185v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in generative AI have enabled assistants to generate increasingly sophisticated executable unit tests. However, novices may accept these outputs without independently identifying what to test, evaluating test-suite completeness, or verifying correctness, potentially limiting opportunities to develop essential testing skills. Although prior work has explored AI-assisted test generation and feedback-oriented programming tutors, little is known about whether AI can support novices' testing practices without generating tests for them. To investigate this, we introduce TestCompass, a generative AI tutor that provides targeted feedback on weaknesses in students' test suites without generating executable tests. In a classroom study with 18 students, we compared TestCompass with a general AI assistant across two Java unit-testing tasks, examining students' testing behaviors, test-suite quality, and subjective experiences. translated_title: AI能否在不生成测试的情况下指导测试？一项关于AI辅助单元测试的对比研究
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能的最新进展使AI助手能够生成日益复杂的可执行单元测试。然而，初学者可能会直接接受这些输出，而不去独立思考应该测试什么、评估测试套件的完整性或验证其正确性，这可能限制他们发展关键测试技能的机会。尽管先前的研究已经探索了AI辅助测试生成以及面向反馈的编程辅导工具，但对于AI能否在不为初学者生成测试的情况下支持他们的测试实践，人们仍然知之甚少。为了探究这一问题，我们提出了TestCompass——一个生成式AI辅导工具，它针对学生测试套件中的薄弱环节提供有针对性的反馈，但并不生成可执行的测试。在一项包含18名学生的课堂研究中，我们在两个Java单元测试任务上将TestCompass与通用AI助手进行了对比，考察了学生的测试行为、测试套件质量以及主观体验。（摘要原文在此处中断）
tldr: 该研究提出TestCompass——一个不代学生生成可执行测试、而是针对其测试套件薄弱点提供定向反馈的生成式AI辅导工具，并通过18名学生的课堂对比实验证明AI可以在不直接生成测试的前提下有效支持初学者的单元测试学习。
en_tdlr: This study introduces TestCompass, a generative AI tutor that supports novices' unit testing by providing targeted feedback on weaknesses in their test suites without generating executable tests, and a classroom study with 18 students compares it against a general AI assistant across two Java unit-testing tasks.
